messages:
Renee Carter: Heads-up — webinar registrants are getting stuck while we wait for enrichment. We lose the hot 1st-touch window. Need an "immediate claim" flow for event leads.
Diego Ortiz: proposal: if payload contains quick_claim=true then HubSpot should immediately assign to queue 'event-claim' with metadata partial=true. Enrichment must PATCH only and run asynchronously. SLA target: 4m accept window for event-claim.
Hannah Li: SF note: our Salesforce automations will reassign unless we upsert with preserve_owner_mode=true. I'll add that flag to the connector mapping.
Marcus Cole: technical ask: enrichment job should never overwrite owner_id unless owner==null. Also add a check: if enrichment finishes before accept, include quality_score but do not change assignment.
eng-bot: webhook smoke OK (200). sample incoming: {"email":"attendee@example.com","campaign":"product-deepdive","quick_claim":"true","x-rollout":"canary"}
Renee Carter: fallback: if no accept in 4m -> escalate to 'sdr-overflow' and post note "auto-escalated: no-accept within SLA". Also ping #marketing-sdr.
Diego Ortiz: canary plan: x-rollout=canary header, start at 2% traffic. Metrics to watch: accept_rate, median_accept_ms, post-enrich_owner_flips. Alert if median_accept_ms > 240000ms or accept_rate < 65% in first 30m.
Hannah Li: SD R playbook: when profile is partial -> 1) call within SLA, 2) verify company+title, 3) update note "partial-profile: follow-up", 4) if contact missing use backup flow. I'll post short scripts in #marketing.
Marcus Cole: observability events: lead.claim.immediate, lead.accept.ms, lead.enrich.patch.ms. Add dashboard with rolling 30m windows and a heatmap of enrichment latency.
Renee Carter: timeline: implement hubspot flag + SF preserve_owner_mode today, run canary tomorrow 0900, ramp to 20% after 1hr if green.
Diego Ortiz: I'll add unit tests for SF connector and an automated rollback playbook.
Renee Carter: thanks folks  want this live before the webinar on Monday. :rocket:
